shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated pendant/vertical or triangular marks
justification: The strongest correspondence is the use of schematic low-relief/incised motifs including a horizontal patterned band with repeated pendant marks and some circular/disc forms. The biggest difference is that A is organized as decoration on the back of an anthropomorphic figure with belt-like bands and sparse symbols, while B is a rectangular panel composition with multiple clear animal figures arranged in registers.
